name: Upper Intermediate
title: Argue, Present, Persuade
tagline: Work, study and debate in German with fluency and nuance.
overview: B2 is about control. You will move beyond correct sentences into well-built texts: nominalisation, participial attributes, reported speech and structured argument. The lessons train the German used in job interviews, university presentations and professional meetings, with register and style treated as part of grammar.
levelGoal: By the end of B2 you can understand complex texts, present a structured argument, take part in professional discussions and write formal texts with a clear line of reasoning.
canDo: Follow complex articles, lectures and professional discussions.
Present and defend an argument with counterarguments.
Write formal reports, essays and application documents.
Communicate effectively in job interviews and meetings.

modules.title: Advanced Syntax
modules.summary: Dense, precise German: subordinate structures, nominal style and participial attributes.

lessons.title: Advanced Subordinate Clauses
lessons.summary: Add precision with während, sobald, sodass, indem and anstatt … zu.
objectives: Use temporal, consecutive and modal subordinate clauses.
Maintain verb-final word order in longer clauses.
Combine several clauses without losing clarity.

keyPhrase.de: Sobald ich die Ergebnisse habe, melde ich mich.
keyPhrase.en: As soon as I have the results, I will get in touch.

lessons.title: Nominalisation
lessons.summary: Turn verbs into nouns to write compactly — without making your text unreadable.
objectives: Form nouns from verbs and adjectives.
Convert verbal sentences into nominal phrases.
Recognise when nominal style helps and when it obscures meaning.

keyPhrase.de: Die Durchführung des Projekts wurde verschoben.
keyPhrase.en: The implementation of the project was postponed.

lessons.title: Participial Constructions
lessons.summary: Compress relative clauses into elegant extended attributes.
objectives: Form present and past participles as adjectives.
Build extended participial attributes before a noun.
Decide when a relative clause is clearer.
Understand the difference between -end and ge- forms.

keyPhrase.de: Die zu erledigenden Aufgaben sind klar.
keyPhrase.en: The tasks to be completed are clear.

modules.title: Argument & Perspective
modules.summary: Report what others say, explore hypotheticals and build a convincing essay.

lessons.title: Konjunktiv I & Reported Speech
lessons.summary: Report statements neutrally in journalism and academic writing.
objectives: Form Konjunktiv I in all relevant persons.
Report statements without committing to their truth.
Use the replacement Konjunktiv II forms where needed.

keyPhrase.en: He says that he is ill.

lessons.title: Hypotheses with Konjunktiv II
lessons.summary: Discuss what would happen if things were different.
objectives: Build conditional sentences with wenn and Konjunktiv II.
Use hätte, wäre and würde accurately in hypotheticals.
Distinguish realistic conditions from unreal ones.

keyPhrase.de: Wenn ich mehr Zeit hätte, würde ich öfter lesen.
keyPhrase.en: If I had more time, I would read more often.

lessons.title: Argumentative Essays & Connectors
lessons.summary: Structure a thesis, body and conclusion with contrast and consequence.
objectives: Write a clear thesis statement and a logical conclusion.
Use einerseits/andererseits, dennoch and folglich effectively.
Integrate counterarguments and refute them politely.

keyPhrase.de: Einerseits spart es Zeit, andererseits ist es teuer.
keyPhrase.en: On the one hand it saves time; on the other hand it is expensive.

modules.title: Professional German
modules.summary: Applications, meetings and presentations where clarity matters most.

lessons.title: Job Interviews & Applications
lessons.summary: Present your experience, strengths and motivation in a German interview.
objectives: Introduce your professional background concisely.
Give concrete examples of strengths and challenges.
Write a short cover letter with an appropriate tone.

keyPhrase.de: Ich bringe zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Marketing mit.
keyPhrase.en: I bring two years of experience in marketing.

lessons.title: Meetings & Negotiations
lessons.summary: Propose, clarify, disagree and find a compromise professionally.
objectives: Set an agenda and keep a meeting on track.
Make, accept and reject proposals diplomatically.
Summarise decisions and next steps.

keyPhrase.de: Ich schlage vor, dass wir einen Kompromiss finden.
keyPhrase.en: I suggest that we find a compromise.

lessons.title: Presentations & Academic Vocabulary
lessons.summary: Signpost a presentation clearly and sound credible in academic German.
objectives: Introduce, structure and conclude a presentation.
Use signposting phrases for transitions and emphasis.
Apply common academic nouns and verbs accurately.

keyPhrase.en: In summary, it can be said that …

modules.title: Style & Nuance
modules.summary: Idioms, academic structures and the fine art of sounding natural.

lessons.title: Idioms & Collocations
lessons.summary: Learn which words naturally go together — and a few idioms worth knowing.
objectives: Recognise high-frequency noun–verb collocations.
Use common idioms in appropriate contexts.
Avoid literal translations that sound unnatural.

keyPhrase.de: Diese Entscheidung spielt eine wichtige Rolle.
keyPhrase.en: This decision plays an important role.

lessons.title: Formal Writing Workshop
lessons.summary: Rewrite clunky texts into clear, cohesive formal German.
objectives: Improve cohesion with pronouns and connectors.
Replace vague verbs and repeated words.
Edit register, tone and sentence length.

keyPhrase.de: Aus den genannten Gründen befürworte ich …
keyPhrase.en: For the reasons mentioned, I support …

lessons.title: Complex Adjective & Noun Structures
lessons.summary: Genitive phrases and adjective nouns: the compressed language of reports.
objectives: Use the genitive for possession and formal relationships.
Decline adjectives used as nouns.
Decode long noun phrases in academic texts.

keyPhrase.de: Die Bedeutung des wissenschaftlichen Fortschritts ist unumstritten.
keyPhrase.en: The importance of scientific progress is undisputed.
